$comment: Every marimo notebook group on this machine. One 'marimo run' process per group (interpreter + working directory), pinned port, proxied same-origin at /marimo/<slug>. Adding a new root is a JSON edit only (OCP) — no server code changes. Only direct-child *.py files containing 'marimo.App(' in the first 64KB of the source count as notebooks; catalog.ts enforces that at scan time. Ports live below 20000 on purpose: Windows' dynamic/ephemeral TCP range starts at 20000 and Hyper-V reserves blocks inside it (27137-27236 covered every former 2718x pin), which made marimo fail to bind with WinError 10013.
